races.title: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: This looks wide open. BEAUTY CHOICE did well to overcome traffic problems when going in at Redcar recently and is taken to defy a 3 lb higher mark at the chief expense of Golden Strike who bids for a fourth victory of 2026 on the back of his latest York success. Last year's victor Lir Speciale can also have a big say too if shrugging off a lesser effort here last time. King's School completes the shortlist. BEAUTY CHOICE GOLDEN STRIKE (IRE) LIR SPECIALE (IRE)

races.title: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: COUL ANGEL steps up in grade but there has been a lot to like about his recent big-field handicap victories at the Curragh and York (form of both been well advertised ) and he looks very much the way to go. Copacabana Sands could emerge as the main threat if, as expected, building on a recent sixth in the Sceptre Stakes here, while Pellitory and Zen Diva can also have a say. Unique Journey completes the shortlist. COUL ANGEL (IRE) COPACABANA SANDS (IRE) PELLITORY

races.title: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: The exciting ALFRED WINCHAM had so much in hand at York that even a 13 lb hike doesn't look enough to stop him. 2024 winner Lord Melbourne looks to have been targeted at this again and is feared most on the back of an encouraging run at York last month. Castle Cove has been absent since winning this last year but his good record fresh means it would come as no surprise were he to go well again. The reliable Say What You See should also have a say, while Nobody Knows is the unexposed one. ALFRED WINCHAM (IRE) LORD MELBOURNE (IRE) CASTLE COVE (IRE)
